question: What was used in the Vedic period as a unit of money in the barter system? (RPF Constable 2024 (06/03/2025) Shift 3)
options: Cattle
Arms
Silver coins
Copper coins
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Cattle

Explanation:
In the Vedic period, the barter system was prevalent, and cattle (especially cows) were used as a unit of money. Cows were considered a symbol of wealth and were used in transactions. The Rigveda uses the term 'gavyuti' meaning exchange of cows. Silver or copper coins were not in circulation during this period; later in the post-Vedic period, 'nishka' (a gold ornament) was used as currency. Cattle were the most common medium of exchange.

☛ Term for barter in Rigveda → Gavyuti
☛ Post-Vedic currency → Nishka (gold ornament)
☛ Measure of wealth in Vedic age → Number of cows
☛ Basis of Vedic economy → Pastoralism and agriculture
question_hi: वैदिक काल में वस्तु विनिमय प्रणाली में मुद्रा की इकाई के रूप में क्या प्रयोग किया जाता था? (RPF Constable 2024 (06/03/2025) Shift 3)

हथियार
चांदी के सिक्के
तांबे के सिक्के
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है पशु

Explanation:
वैदिक काल में वस्तु विनिमय प्रणाली प्रचलित थी, जिसमें मुद्रा की इकाई के रूप में पशु (विशेषकर गाय) का प्रयोग किया जाता था। गाय को धन का प्रतीक माना जाता था और इसका उपयोग लेन-देन में किया जाता था। ऋग्वेद में 'गव्यूति' शब्द का अर्थ गायों का आदान-प्रदान होता है। इस काल में चांदी या तांबे के सिक्के प्रचलन में नहीं थे; बाद में उत्तर वैदिक काल में 'निष्क' नामक स्वर्ण आभूषण का उपयोग मुद्रा के रूप में हुआ। पशु सबसे सामान्य विनिमय माध्यम था।

question: Which of the following archaeologists started excavations in the Harappa site of the Indus Valley civilisation in 1920-21? (RPF Constable 2024 (07/03/2025) Shift 1)
options: Ernest Mackay
Daya Ram Sahni
Sir John Hubert Marshall
Rakhal Das Banerjee
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Daya Ram Sahni

Explanation:
In 1920-21, Daya Ram Sahni of the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) started the first systematic excavations at the Harappa site. These excavations revealed remnants of the Indus Valley Civilisation, an ancient civilisation in the Indian subcontinent. Subsequently, Rakhal Das Banerjee (Mohenjo-daro), Sir John Marshall (ASI Director-General), and Ernest Mackay (assistant excavator) also played key roles. The Harappan civilisation flourished from around 3300-1300 BCE and is one of the world's major ancient civilisations.

question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस पुरातत्वविद् ने 1920-21 में सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता की हड़प्पा स्थल पर खुदाई शुरू की थी? (RPF Constable 2024 (07/03/2025) Shift 1)
options_hi: अर्नेस्ट मैके
दया राम साहनी
सर जॉन ह्यूबर्ट मार्शल
रखाल दास बनर्जी
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है दया राम साहनी

Explanation:
1920-21 में, भारतीय पुरातत्व सर्वेक्षण (ए.एस.आई.) के तहत दया राम साहनी ने हड़प्पा स्थल पर पहली बार व्यवस्थित खुदाई शुरू की थी। इस खुदाई से सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता के अवशेष मिले, जो भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप की एक प्राचीन सभ्यता थी। बाद में रखाल दास बनर्जी (मोहनजोदड़ो), सर जॉन मार्शल (ए.एस.आई. महानिदेशक) और अर्नेस्ट मैके (खुदाई में सहायक) ने भी महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई। हड़प्पा सभ्यता लगभग 3300-1300 ईसा पूर्व तक फैली थी और यह दुनिया की प्रमुख प्राचीन सभ्यताओं में से एक है।

question: Which of the following was the smallest administrative unit in the Mauryan Empire? (RPF Constable 2024 (07/03/2025) Shift 2)
options: Village
Province
Town
District
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Village

Explanation:
In the Mauryan Empire, the administrative structure was hierarchical. The smallest unit was the village, headed by an official called gramika or gramani. Several villages formed a sangrahana, administered by a sangrahanadhyaksha. The next level was vithi, comprising multiple sangrahanas. The largest administrative unit was the province (called rajya or pradesh). This hierarchy ensured coordination between the central and local levels. Detailed information about this administrative system is found in Chanakya's Arthashastra.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Smallest administrative unit in Mauryan Empire? → Village
☛ Head of a village called? → Gramika or Gramani
☛ Group of villages called? → Sangrahana
☛ Head of a Sangrahana? → Sangrahanadhyaksha
☛ Main source describing Mauryan administration? → Arthashastra

नगर
जिला

Explanation:
मौर्य साम्राज्य में प्रशासनिक इकाइयों का एक क्रमबद्ध ढांचा था। सबसे छोटी इकाई ग्राम थी, जिसका प्रमुख ग्रामिक या ग्रामणी कहलाता था। कई ग्राम मिलकर एक संग्रहण बनाते थे, जिसका प्रशासन संग्रहणाध्यक्ष देखता था। अगली इकाई वीथी थी, जिसमें कई संग्रहण शामिल होते थे। प्रांत सबसे बड़ी प्रशासनिक इकाई थी, जिसे राज्य या प्रदेश कहा जाता था। मौर्य प्रशासन में केंद्र और स्थानीय स्तर के बीच समन्वय के लिए यह पदानुक्रम आवश्यक था। चाणक्य के अर्थशास्त्र में इस प्रशासनिक व्यवस्था का विस्तृत वर्णन मिलता है।

question: Which of the following Gupta rulers defeated Shaka King Rudrasimha III and captured his kingdom? (RPF Constable 2024 (07/03/2025) Shift 2)
options: Kumaragupta
Chandragupta II
Chandragupta I
Skandagupta
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Chandragupta II

Explanation:
The Gupta ruler Chandragupta II (also known as Vikramaditya) defeated the Shaka Kshatrapas and established control over western India. He vanquished the Shaka king Rudrasimha III and annexed regions such as Gujarat, Kathiawar, and Malwa into the Gupta Empire. This victory was one of the most significant achievements of Chandragupta II's reign, greatly expanding the Gupta territory. After this conquest, he assumed titles like 'Vikramaditya' and 'Shakari' (destroyer of Shakas). Chandragupta II is regarded as the most powerful ruler of the Gupta dynasty, under whom the empire reached its zenith in both political power and cultural prosperity.

☛ Goddess depicted on Chandragupta II's coins → Lakshmi
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस गुप्त शासक ने शक राजा रुद्रसिंह तृतीय को पराजित किया और उसका राज्य जीत लिया? (RPF Constable 2024 (07/03/2025) Shift 2)
options_hi: कुमारगुप्त
चंद्रगुप्त द्वितीय
चंद्रगुप्त प्रथम
स्कंदगुप्त
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है चंद्रगुप्त द्वितीय

Explanation:
गुप्त वंश के शासक चंद्रगुप्त द्वितीय (विक्रमादित्य) ने शक क्षत्रपों को पराजित कर पश्चिमी भारत पर अपना नियंत्रण स्थापित किया। उसने शक राजा रुद्रसिंह तृतीय को हराकर गुजरात, काठियावाड़ और मालवा क्षेत्रों को गुप्त साम्राज्य में मिलाया। यह विजय चंद्रगुप्त द्वितीय के शासनकाल की सबसे महत्वपूर्ण उपलब्धियों में से एक थी, जिसने गुप्त साम्राज्य के विस्तार में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई। इस विजय के बाद उसने 'विक्रमादित्य' और 'शकारि' जैसी उपाधियाँ धारण कीं। चंद्रगुप्त द्वितीय को गुप्त साम्राज्य का सबसे शक्तिशाली शासक माना जाता है, जिसने साम्राज्य को सांस्कृतिक और राजनीतिक रूप से समृद्ध किया।

question: What was the role of the ‘Rajanya’ in society during the Vedic period? (RPF Constable 2024 (07/03/2025) Shift 3)
options: Kings and warriors
Farmers and labourers
Priests and scholars
Merchants and traders
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Kings and warriors

Explanation:
During the Vedic period, society was divided into four varnas. The Rajanya varna consisted of kings and warriors. This varna was equivalent to the Kshatriya varna, whose main duties were governance and warfare. The Rajanya people ensured the security and order of society. They received income from land and taxes. The Rigveda mentions Rajanya as a prominent varna.

question: Who among the following was the court poet of Samudragupta? (RPF Constable 2024 (07/03/2025) Shift 3)
options: Vatsyayana
Bharavi
Harishena
Kalidasa
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Harishena

Explanation:
The court poet of Samudragupta was Harishena. Harishena was a renowned poet, minister, and general. He composed the Prayag Prashasti (Allahabad Pillar Inscription), which describes the military campaigns and achievements of Samudragupta. This inscription is written in Sanskrit and is a crucial source of Gupta history. Harishena bestowed titles such as 'Kaviraj' and 'Lichchhavi Dauhitra' upon Samudragupta. The inscription details Samudragupta's conquests, cultural patronage, and administrative capabilities. Among the other options, Vatsyayana authored the Kamasutra, Bharavi wrote Kiratarjuniya, and Kalidasa was the court poet of Chandragupta II.

☛ Which titles were given to Samudragupta? → Kaviraj and Lichchhavi Dauhitra
☛ Which is the most famous inscription of the Gupta period? → Prayag Prashasti (Allahabad Pillar)
☛ Kalidasa was the court poet of which Gupta ruler? → Chandragupta II
☛ Which epic was written by Bharavi? → Kiratarjuniya
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन समुद्रगुप्त का दरबारी कवि था? (RPF Constable 2024 (07/03/2025) Shift 3)
options_hi: वात्सयायन
भरवि
हरिषेण
कालिदास
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है हरिषेण

Explanation:
समुद्रगुप्त के दरबारी कवि हरिषेण थे। हरिषेण एक प्रसिद्ध कवि, मंत्री और सेनापति थे। उन्होंने समुद्रगुप्त की विजयों का वर्णन करते हुए प्रयाग प्रशस्ति (इलाहाबाद स्तंभ शिलालेख) की रचना की। यह अभिलेख संस्कृत भाषा में लिखा गया है और गुप्त काल के इतिहास का महत्वपूर्ण स्रोत है। हरिषेण ने समुद्रगुप्त को 'कविराज' और 'लिच्छवि दौहित्र' जैसी उपाधियों से विभूषित किया। प्रयाग प्रशस्ति में समुद्रगुप्त की सैन्य उपलब्धियों, सांस्कृतिक योगदान और प्रशासनिक क्षमता का विस्तृत उल्लेख मिलता है। अन्य विकल्पों में, वात्सायन कामसूत्र के रचयिता हैं, भारवि किरातार्जुनीयम् के कवि थे, और कालिदास चंद्रगुप्त द्वितीय के दरबारी कवि थे।

question: Who was the first ruler of the Gupta dynasty to adopt the grand title of Maharajadhiraja? (RPF Constable 2024 (09/03/2025) Shift 1)
options: Vishnugupta
Chandragupta I
Skandagupta
Kumaragupta
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Chandragupta I

Explanation:
In the Gupta dynasty, Chandragupta I (319–335 CE) was the first ruler to adopt the grand title of Maharajadhiraja (King of Kings). Earlier rulers like Ghatotkacha and Sri Gupta used lesser titles such as Maharaja. Chandragupta I strengthened his position by marrying the Lichchhavi princess Kumaradevi, which gave the Gupta dynasty political prestige. He initiated the Gupta era, also known as the Chandragupta I era, during his reign. His coins bear the title Maharajadhiraja, reflecting his supremacy over other kings. Thus, Chandragupta I established the Gupta Empire as an imperial power.

☛ Who was the first independent ruler of the Gupta dynasty? → Ghatotkacha
☛ With which dynasty did Chandragupta I establish a marital alliance? → Lichchhavi
☛ What title appears on Chandragupta I's coins? → Maharajadhiraja
☛ Who started the Gupta era? → Chandragupta I

question: From which site of the Indus Valley Civilisation was the ‘Dancing Girl’, a bronze figurine, found? (RPF Constable 2024 (09/03/2025) Shift 2)

question: The book ‘Sutta Pitaka’ contains the words of which religious preacher? (RPF Constable 2024 (09/03/2025) Shift 3)

Explanation:

The Sutta Pitaka elaborates on Buddha's life and core principles such as the Middle Way, Four Noble Truths, and Eightfold Path.

मेगस्थनीज एक यूनानी राजदूत था जिसे सेल्यूकस निकेटर ने चंद्रगुप्त मौर्य के दरबार में भेजा था। सेल्यूकस पश्चिम एशिया का यूनानी शासक था और उसने चंद्रगुप्त के साथ संधि की थी। मेगस्थनीज ने भारत की यात्रा की और अपनी पुस्तक इंडिका में मौर्य साम्राज्य, समाज, प्रशासन और भूगोल का विस्तृत वर्णन किया। यह पुस्तक मौर्य काल के बारे में महत्वपूर्ण ऐतिहासिक स्रोत है। मेगस्थनीज ने पाटलिपुत्र (वर्तमान पटना) का भी दौरा किया और वहां के शहरी जीवन का वर्णन किया।

question_hi:

question: The four Vedas, together with their Brahmanas are also known as ______. (RPF Constable 2024 (11/03/2025) Shift 1)
options: Vedangas
Shruti
Upavedas
Puranas
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Shruti

Explanation:
The Vedas are called 'Shruti', meaning 'that which is heard'. They are believed to be divine knowledge heard by ancient sages. The four Vedas along with their Brahmanas (texts explaining Vedic rituals) are also classified as Shruti. Shruti is considered apaurusheya (not composed by humans) and is the highest authority in Hinduism. In contrast, Vedangas, Upavedas, and Puranas fall under Smriti (remembered texts). Therefore, the correct answer is Shruti.

श्रुति
उपवेद
पुराण
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है श्रुति

Explanation:
वेदों को 'श्रुति' कहा जाता है, जिसका अर्थ है 'जो सुना गया'। माना जाता है कि वेद ऋषियों द्वारा सुने गए दिव्य ज्ञान हैं। चार वेदों के साथ उनके ब्राह्मण ग्रंथ भी श्रुति के अंतर्गत आते हैं। ब्राह्मण ग्रंथ वैदिक अनुष्ठानों और यज्ञों की व्याख्या करते हैं। श्रुति को अपौरुषेय (मनुष्य द्वारा रचित नहीं) माना जाता है और यह हिंदू धर्म का सर्वोच्च धार्मिक ग्रंथ है। वेदांग, उपवेद और पुराण स्मृति के अंतर्गत आते हैं, श्रुति के नहीं। अतः सही उत्तर श्रुति है।

question: In the Vedic period, which of the following was considered the highest social class of society? (RPF Constable 2024 (11/03/2025) Shift 3)
options: Shudra
Kshatriya
Brahmin
Vaishya
solution:

Explanation:
In the Vedic period, society was divided into four varnas: Brahmins, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas, and Shudras. Brahmins were considered the highest social class because they were responsible for religious rituals, study of the Vedas, and education. They were the spiritual and intellectual leaders of society. Kshatriyas were kings and warriors, Vaishyas engaged in trade and agriculture, while Shudras served the other three varnas. The varna system was based on birth and was seen as a part of social order.

question: The word 'vaishya' comes from which word in the Vedic period? (RPF Constable 2024 (11/03/2025) Shift 3)

question: Which of the following was the unique feature of Dholavira’s city layout during the Indus Valley Civilisation? (RPF Constable 2024 (12/03/2025) Shift 1)
options: It was a single unique tomb.
It was divided into two distinct parts.
It was divided into eight parts.
It was divided into three distinct parts.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is It was divided into three distinct parts.

Explanation:
Dholavira, located in the Kutch district of Gujarat, is a major site of the Indus Valley Civilisation. Its most unique feature was its city layout divided into three distinct parts: the citadel, the middle town, and the lower town. This division suggests a clear social or administrative stratification. Dholavira also had an advanced water management system, including reservoirs and channels. A remarkable find from the site is a signboard with large-sized letters of the Indus script, one of the longest known inscriptions. Additionally, a scale with ten divisions was discovered, indicating precise measurement systems. The planned layout and sophisticated water harvesting techniques make Dholavira a unique example of urban planning in the Indus Valley.

question: Which of the following Indus Valley sites was discovered by Rakhal Das Bannerjee? (RPF Constable 2024 (12/03/2025) Shift 1)
options: Surkotada
Kalibangan
Mohenjo-Daro
Harappa
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Mohenjo-Daro

Explanation:
Among the major sites of the Indus Valley Civilization, Mohenjo-Daro was discovered in 1922 by Rakhal Das Bannerjee. Located in present-day Sindh, Pakistan, its name means 'Mound of the Dead'. Key findings include the Great Bath, Great Granary, and Pashupati Seal. Harappa was discovered by Dayaram Sahni, Kalibangan by Amlanand Ghosh, and Surkotada by J.P. Joshi. Mohenjo-Daro is considered the most advanced city of the Indus civilization, featuring an elaborate drainage system and brick-built structures. It was a major urban center with evidence of trade, craftsmanship, and social organization.

question: Which of the following Mauryan rulers is known for his support of Buddhism and spreading its teachings? (RPF Constable 2024 (12/03/2025) Shift 3)
options: Bindusara
Chandragupta Maurya
Ashoka
Brihadratha
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Ashoka

Explanation:
The Mauryan emperor Ashoka (268-232 BCE) is renowned for his patronage and propagation of Buddhism. After the devastating Kalinga War (261 BCE), Ashoka embraced Buddhism and renounced violence. He promoted the principles of Dhamma and sent Buddhist missionaries across India and to regions like Sri Lanka, Myanmar, Nepal, and Afghanistan. His edicts inscribed on rocks and pillars spread Buddhist teachings. Ashoka built the Mahabodhi Temple in Bodh Gaya and the Lion Capital of Ashoka at Sarnath. He also convened the Third Buddhist Council at Pataliputra to purify the sangha. Ashoka's support made Buddhism a major world religion.
